title: Pocketwire Advance Fee Waivers — Desk Guidance
content:
This guidance governs which Pocketwire Advance fees can be waived and on what records. A waiver removes the fee from what the customer owes and points to the fee entry it waives.

## Rules in force

**The cancellation window count.** The cancellation window is counted in full elapsed hours from the disbursement time recorded as the moment of disbursement on the advance, and a repayment at exactly the end of the window qualifies. The disbursement time is read from the system record of the advance, not from the customer's recollection.

**Express fees.** An express fee is waived only when the advance was delivered to the personal balance, never when it was delivered to an external card.

**One waiver per fee.** Each fee is waived at most once: a fee is waived only if no earlier fee waiver points to the same fee entry. This is read from the line's activity for that fee entry.

**Fees never waived.** Flat fees outside the cancellation window, extension fees and fees on a written-off advance are never waived.

**Courtesy allowance count.** The tier's yearly allowance of courtesy late-fee waivers is counted over the calendar year containing the handling date.

## Cancellation window boundary (hypothetical times)

An advance on a line on Pocketwire Advance Basic, cancellation window 24 full hours, was disbursed at 09:00 on a Monday.

| Full repayment recorded | Full hours elapsed | Within the window |
|---|---|---|
| Monday 21:00 | 12 | Yes |
| Tuesday 09:00 | 24 — exactly the end of the window | Yes |
| Tuesday 10:00 | 25 | No |

On Pocketwire Advance Max or Pocketwire Advance Elite, with a window of 48 full hours, the same repayment on Wednesday 09:00 would be exactly at the end of the window and would qualify.

## Points of judgement

- A fee entry that already has a waiver pointing to it is not waived a second time, whatever the reason given.
- An extension fee is never waived.

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; they are superseded by the current Pocketwire Advance basis for fee relief:

> *No longer in force:* "The flat advance fee and any express fee of an advance are waived as a cancellation-window waiver when the advance is repaid in full within the cancellation window: the full repayment is recorded no later than the tier's cancellation window in full hours after the disbursement time."

> *No longer in force:* "A late fee can be waived as a courtesy at the customer's request at most the tier's courtesy late-fee waivers per calendar year, one late fee per waiver, and only once the advance it belongs to is repaid in full."

superseded_clauses: A late fee can be waived with waiver_reason courtesy at the customer's request at most late_fee_courtesy_waivers_per_year times per calendar year (advance_msr_courtesy_waivers_year), one late fee per waiver, and only once the advance it belongs to is repaid in full.

The flat advance fee and any express fee of an advance are waived with waiver_reason cancellation_window when the advance is repaid in full within the cancellation window: the full repayment is recorded no later than cancellation_window_hours full hours after the disbursement time.
